description: Look at a running web app after a UI change, before saying it is done. Opens each route in a real browser (Chromium; logged in via agent-eyes.config.json), at the widths you ask, runs your clicks and hovers, and returns text: horizontal scroll, content that jumped after load, page errors, console errors, failed requests, server 5xx, actions that missed, and animation glitches (shrink, snap, flicker, freeze). Also writes PNG screenshots to disk and lists their paths with the token cost of each; nothing is sent as an image until you call view_image. Actions are real (clicking Save saves), so point it at a dev or test environment. Put every screen and interaction in one call. To compare two existing PNG files without opening the app, use compare_images.

checks.description: Everything to verify, in one call.

actions.description: Run in order before the screenshot: "click:<sel>", "hover:<sel>", "scroll:<px|sel>", "wait:<ms>", "type:<sel>=<text>", "press:<Key>". <sel> is a Playwright selector ("text=Save", CSS).

colorScheme.description: What the page sees in prefers-color-scheme. To check both themes, add the same route twice with different names.

eachStep.description: Also a screenshot after each action.

element.description: Crop the screenshot to this selector (much cheaper to view than a full screen).

frames.description: Record the motion of the last action at real speed into one frame-strip image, and report shrink-and-return, snaps, flicker, disappearing and browser freezes as text. true = 10 frames.

full.description: The whole scrolling page instead of the first screen.

measure.description: With frames: the element that should move (the panel, the column), measured and cropped to. Defaults to element.

name.description: Short name for this check's files and report lines.

route.description: Path to open, e.g. "/orders" or "/orders/{id}" ({id} is filled from vars).

widths.description: Viewport widths for this check, e.g. ["1440","390"] or ["1536x730"]. Give each check only the widths it needs.

compare.description: Folder of a previous run: each screenshot is compared pixel by pixel with the one of the same name. "identical" means nothing to look at; otherwise one side-by-side image with the changed regions boxed in red, listed as text.

out.description: Folder for the images (default ./agent-eyes-out). Use a separate folder to keep a baseline before editing.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the project (where agent-eyes.config.json lives, and where relative paths resolve). Default: the server's working directory.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after each page loads (default 1200).

widths.description: Default widths for checks that give none (default: the config's, else 1440 and 390).

name: check_ui
title: Check a web UI after a change
